verdict: No real winners. Overuse of the large capital font, looks like a conference. Directions are mostly variations in colour and some layout; the section patterns are practically the same, like the company event formats section.

kept.element: Closing band: full-width vertical violet-to-lilac gradient, centred headline, email as a solid dark pill
kept.note: potential, but not with that headline font

kept.element: Project header (Future Boutique): soft radial gradient in the series accent, label, big title, intro, outline pill specialties, wavy underline on the active nav item
kept.note: potential, but not with that headline font

kept.element: Pillars as two full colour fields (yellow, violet), specialty count label, big pillar name, intro, specialties in two columns under hairline rules
kept.note: potential, but not with that headline font

wanted: Break out of the grid; stay approachable, a little subversive, avant-garde, minimal, with some brutalist touch
No generic serif and sans serif fonts
No wave backgrounds; gradients good if subtle and full width; grainy abstract gradient
Keep the palette but use fewer colours: a neutral background and bold button colours
Feel editorial, boutique, specialist and creative
Expand the About page into several sections, loosely based on Jasmin's LinkedIn and Instagram
